Recorded claim:
Route attributes remain authoritative: skip loading in create mode; require `calendar-id` and `event-id` in edit mode, with optional `recurrence-id`. Normal consumers use `storeObserver`-selected state, not `sourceState`/`sourceEvent` getters; change routes atomically with `setCalendarEventRoute({ calendarId, eventId, recurrenceId })`. [Task 1]
